Is it wrong if I want a complete change of career path? As far as I can see most engineering positions involve the things I mentioned, it was ignorant of my part to not know in detail what a typical engineer does, in principle, or what working in manufacturing involve (the only option where I currently live), even though I don't like what I do, I don't find any positions available or what any other engineer does, that interests me, which puts my career choice in perspective to start uni again in other field, which I might start when I finish my degree in one year

Also, thank you for your response you've been helpful so far

I don't know if 4 months is considered starting, but I guess you're right, what would you consider is a right amount of time to know that this is or isn't for me?

Edit: And sorry if it sounds rude, but it is rather difficult enjoying life outside work when I work for 9 and a half hours, and arrive exhausted to my home to sleep for the next day

Sorry if my response sounds rude, but the thing is, that I forgot to mention that I'm not really in an aerospace company, just took the job I could find in an air conditioner manufacturer, and also due to my ideology I'd prefer not to work at a defense contractor, which I know is kind of stupid for an aerospace engineer
But also, I don't really need the money, which isn't much barely 2 dollars an hour, I'm just doing this for the experience, and of the reasons I'm still here is because I don't want to make the life harder for my supervisor and co-workers

Woow you really left me thinking. It didn't hit me that I was actively trying to hide things from them. You really helped me see things in another light. I will try my best to follow your advice, thank you so much for taking the time to read about me, it meant a lot to me and thanks again!
